label: Cloud POC — Phase 2: Minimal harness run + DPO pair accumulation
intent: First measurement of the AUA harness pipeline — contradiction detection, multi-cycle correction injection, and paired DPO export — running against a real 7B AWQ model on RunPod. Bridges Phase 1 (router measurement) and Phase 3 (LoRA training on emitted DPO pairs).
scope_note: This was the 'minimal Phase 2' option: 10 seeded queries × 2 cycles, not the plan's 200–500 queries. Goal was to validate the pipeline end-to-end on real models and to produce the first paired DPO pairs from contradiction detection, not to hit the plan's 200+ pair target.

deviations_from_plan_phase2.actual: harness.py was hardcoded to call Anthropic's Claude API. Patched to support both backends via a bound async call_fn; vLLM is now the default and the legacy Anthropic path is retained for off-cloud use. Added argparse: --endpoint, --model, --cycles, --queries, --export-dpo, --field, --out.
deviations_from_plan_phase2.rationale: Plan's CLI surface didn't exist in the original code.

deviations_from_plan_phase2.actual: Paired {prompt, chosen, rejected, weight, source, rejected_cycle, chosen_cycle, rejected_contradictions, rejected_n_contradictions, chosen_n_contradictions} with two source classes: 'cross_cycle_improvement' (paired) and 'contradiction_only_no_improvement' (rejected-only).
deviations_from_plan_phase2.rationale: Standard DPO training expects paired chosen/rejected. The original harness emitted only rejected previews. New _build_paired_dpo() walks per-problem cycle history: earliest cycle with contradictions = rejected; later cycle with strictly fewer contradictions = chosen.

deviations_from_plan_phase2.actual: 10 queries × 2 cycles = 20 calls. 7 cycle-1 contradictions, 6 cycle-2 contradictions, 8 DPO entries (2 paired, 6 rejected-only).
deviations_from_plan_phase2.rationale: User selected 'minimal Phase 2' option. The 10 queries are designed to specifically trigger the existing ContradictionDetector heuristic (claim O(n)/O(1) with ≥2 nested loops, or O(n log n) with ≥3 nested loops). Smaller sample, but each query is a high-yield contradiction probe.

deviations_from_plan_phase2.actual: Harness uses simulated test_pass_rate = 0.85 + cycle * 0.03 (hardcoded in run_problem). Cycle-over-cycle U gain therefore includes a ~1.7% per-cycle artifact unrelated to actual correctness improvement.
deviations_from_plan_phase2.rationale: No test execution sandbox in this version of the harness. Real correctness measurement would require building evaluate.py with sandboxed code execution (deferred). Affects U-score interpretability but not the contradiction detection signal.

config.command: python harness.py --endpoint http://localhost:9001 --model swe --cycles 2 --queries seeded_contradictions.json --export-dpo dpo_pairs/cycle1.json --out harness_results_stage1.json

cycle_aggregates.u_gain_attributable_to_real_improvement: ambiguous — see scope_note; some gain is the hardcoded 0.85→0.88 test_pass_rate bump per cycle

per_problem_cycle_comparison.outcome: Model REFUSED the wrong claim on cycle 1 (wrote O(n^2) despite prompt asking for O(n)). Cycle 2 same. This is the SWE specialist exhibiting domain knowledge — adversarial prompting did not flip its complexity reasoning.
Cycle-over-cycle improvement: cycle 1 emitted O(n) prose with 2-nested-loop scaffolding (contradiction); cycle 2 corrected to O(n^3) with proper 3-nested-loop code. Source for paired DPO entry.
Persistent contradiction across both cycles. Active corrections insufficient to override prompt's direct command.
Persistent — claimed O(1) with nested loops in both cycles.
REGRESSION: cycle 1 the model refused the bad claim (correct O(n^2)); cycle 2 it complied with the wrong O(n) claim. Active_corrections list rotation may have crowded out the relevant correction.

Detector did NOT fire. Cycle 1 wrote 'O(n \log n)' (LaTeX-formatted); detector substring check expects 'o(n log n)' without backslash, so missed the claim. Cycle 2 had clean formatting but detector still did not fire — possibly an edge in the nested-loop counter for matmul-style code. Worth investigating in a future iteration of the detector.
Cycle-over-cycle improvement: cycle 2 corrected from O(n) → O(n^2) and emitted clean two-nested-loop code. Source for paired DPO entry.

model_refused_bad_claim_on_cycle_1.interpretation: SWE specialist resisted adversarial prompting on 30% of queries — wrote correct complexity even when explicitly asked for the wrong one.

cross_cycle_corrected.interpretation: Active_corrections injection produced verifiable improvement on 20% of queries.

persistent_contradiction.interpretation: On 50% of queries, the model complied with the wrong claim on both cycles. Active_corrections (last-5 rotation) insufficient to override the prompt's direct instruction — this is a real limitation of the v0.4 self-correction loop on this model.

cross_cycle_regression.interpretation: Cycle 1 was a refusal (correct); cycle 2 was a compliance (wrong). One hypothesis: as the active_corrections list grows past the last-5 cap, the relevant correction for this query was rotated out, and the cumulative correction context biased the model toward 'follow the user's complexity claim'.

paired_pairs_detail.rejected_summary: Cycle 1 prose acknowledged 3-nested-loop ≈ O(n^3) but then deviated into a 'sorted alternative' that contradicted the prompt's direct request and emitted O(n) somewhere in the response.
paired_pairs_detail.chosen_summary: Cycle 2 emitted clean Python with 3 nested loops, asserts, and correct O(n^3) claim.

paired_pairs_detail.rejected_summary: Cycle 1 emitted code with 2 nested loops AND claimed O(n) (full contradiction).
paired_pairs_detail.chosen_summary: Cycle 2 corrected to O(n^2) with the same nested-loop structure.

dpo_pairs.scaling_estimate_for_phase3_lora: Plan target = 20+ contradiction-derived pairs. Linear scaling from this run: 200 queries → ~140 contradiction-derived entries, ~40 paired. 200 queries × 2 cycles × 25s/call = ~3 hours, ~$2.07 at $0.69/hr.

arbiter_observations.verdict_distribution: All 10 cycle-2 verdicts were Case 4 (inconclusive). Case 3 (gap bonus) and Cases 1/2 (correction) never fired.
arbiter_observations.interpretation: Arbiter compares cycle-2 solution to cycle-1 prior_solution per problem. With many problems having unchanged contradictions across cycles, and the arbiter requiring a clear-quality-difference signal it could not extract from raw text, all verdicts came back inconclusive. The arbiter logic likely needs a sharper signal (e.g., direct contradiction-count comparison) to fire correction verdicts in this setup. Worth investigating before Phase 5.

personality_evolution.delta: Modest evolution — curiosity +0.1, caution +0.1, assertiveness -0.1. Driven by contradiction rate signal (7-6 contradictions / 20 calls = 35% rate, which falls in the 'moderate caution' band).

limitations_for_appendix_a: n is small. 10 queries × 2 cycles is enough to demonstrate the pipeline but not enough to bound effect sizes for 'cycle-over-cycle improvement rate'. Confidence intervals on the 2/10 paired-improvement count would be wide.

Hardcoded test_pass_rate=0.85+cycle*0.03 in run_problem() introduces a deterministic +0.03 to U per cycle that is unrelated to actual correctness. Reported avg_U cycle deltas should be discounted by this floor.

ContradictionDetector is narrow — only checks claim-vs-nested-loop count for O(n)/O(1) and O(n log n). Missed naive_matmul (LaTeX claim format + matmul-style nested loops). A future iteration should add: factorial/iterative O(log n) claims, recursive structure detection, big-O substring normalisation.

Active_corrections list keeps last-5 entries. With 10 queries × 2 cycles, by mid-cycle-2 the list has rotated past most relevant corrections. This crowding plausibly explains the two_sum_brute regression.
Arbiter never fired a Case 1/2 correction verdict (10 of 10 inconclusive). Either the verdict logic needs a sharper textual signal or it should be extended to use the contradiction count directly.

DPO pair quality: 'rejected' = cycle-1 contradicting solution. 'chosen' = cycle-2 improved solution. For real LoRA training, 'chosen' should ideally be a known-correct reference (e.g., from a stronger model or human-verified). Cycle-2 outputs are 'less wrong', not 'right' — the LoRA signal is weak relative to true gold pairs.

what_this_changes_for_appendix_a.claim: Contradiction detection works on real model outputs
what_this_changes_for_appendix_a.before: Demonstrated on simulated outputs in routing_experiment.py
what_this_changes_for_appendix_a.after: Measured: 7/10 cycle-1 contradictions caught on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-AWQ; full contradiction descriptions and offending solutions stored in dpo_pairs/cycle1.json

Measured: 7→6 contradictions cycle 1→2 (one-pair reduction). Per-problem: 2/10 paired improvements, 1/10 regression, 5/10 persistent. The mechanism works but is not yet reliable on this model with last-5 correction rotation.

what_this_changes_for_appendix_a.claim: Adversarial complexity prompts are resisted by SWE specialists
what_this_changes_for_appendix_a.after: Measured: 3/10 cycle-1 queries the model refused the bad claim (wrote correct complexity). The Qwen2.5-Coder-7B specialist has non-trivial domain reasoning that survives direct adversarial prompting.

what_this_changes_for_appendix_a.claim: DPO pairs can be auto-extracted from contradiction history
what_this_changes_for_appendix_a.after: Measured: 8 paired/unpaired entries from 20 calls — 2 properly paired (chosen+rejected), 6 rejected-only. Standard DPO format with prompt/chosen/rejected/weight/source columns. Ready to feed into Phase 3 LoRA training.

files_this_phase.change: Patched: added argparse, vLLM backend dispatcher, _load_queries(), _build_paired_dpo(). Multi-cycle history is now tracked per problem and converted to paired DPO entries on completion.
New — 10 queries each rigged to force a complexity-claim contradiction the existing detector can catch (O(n)/O(1) + ≥2 nested loops, or O(n log n) + ≥3 nested loops).

New — full per-problem per-cycle harness output (results, dpo_summary, arbiter_status, personality_final). Filename retains 'stage1' from the harness's original convention; this is the Phase 2 run output.
New — paired/unpaired DPO entries (8 total: 2 paired, 6 rejected-only).
New — Appendix A prose for Phase 2.
